notes.title: Undawn: New Version Desert Fury - The Sandstorm has Arrived!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/92701729c11f9a65cb1617d7b6f27f6b7318c2ee.jpg
At the break of dawn, as the raging sands wreak havoc, heroes, are you ready to face new challenges?
Introducing the brand-new version of "Undawn: Desert Fury"! This time, we bring you an unprecedented desert adventure! An intense battle awaits you, the brave ones. Let's unveil the mysterious veil together and explore the secrets behind the fury of the raging sands.

New Map: Mysterious Desert, awaiting your conquest!

In this vast desert, explorers will face harsh environments and dangerous creatures. On this land, you must stand shoulder to shoulder with your teammates to achieve victory.

New Characters: The Raging Sands Heroes make their dazzling debut!

In "Undawn: Desert Fury", all-new heroes bring you incredible combat power and unique skills. Recruit these heroes to join your team and become the ultimate ruler of the Raging Sands!

New Equipment: Desert Treasures to empower your heroes!

While adventuring in the desert, you will have the opportunity to discover precious desert treasures. Collect these treasures to provide your heroes with even more powerful equipment, lending you a helping hand.

Heroes, Desert Fury has arrived. Hurry and grab your weapons, plunge into this thrilling adventure! In the world of Undawn, you will become the legendary figure of the Raging Sands!

WILL YOU SURVIVE THE UNDAWN?

notes.title: Undawn Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/1842c22fe1fb96100ba8a86ac99b25a1ca0beb00.png

Greetings Survivors!

A new hotfix will be going live on June 27, 2023, at 07:00 PDT for the game client.

The hotfix will address the following issues:



 The display issue occuring on the character page for acquired proficiencies is fixed.
 The issue of some homestead items not being found in the store is fixed.
 The issue in some scenarios where the number of free and paid RC was incorrect is fixed.
 The issue where the game on Steam would crash or freeze when exiting from Steam is fixed.


We really appreciate your support for Undawn and are continuing to work towards making the game more enjoyable for you.  Feel free to report any issues below the post or on our Discord channel.

Best Regards,
The Undawn Team
